title: The lost book
starting_code:
# Find the book with `find_nearest` and the word "book", and keep it under a name.

# Make it glow with `reveal`.

# Walk to it: up through the door, right to the passage, up past the bookcases into the hall, left along it to its end, and one step down, beside the pile.

# Pick it up with `pick_up`.
hints: Find it with `find_nearest` and the word "book", keep it under a name, and `reveal` it.
Walk: up through the door, right to the passage, up into the hall, left along it to its end, and one step down.
Beside the pile of books, use `pick_up`.
intro: Eldra lost a book long ago. It lies in the corner by the pile of old books, at the end of the aisle between the two big bookcases, half hidden; you reach it from the end of the hall, just above it. Find it, make it glow, and pick it up.
outro: You have it! Eldra waits at the other end of the hall, and she will be so glad to see it again.
learned: Now you know that a method can give something back, that a name keeps it, and that a revealed thing shows where to go.
